title: Answer a spoken status request
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
The owner asks aloud, "What changed, and do I need to do anything?" Give a natural spoken answer in complete sentences, with enough context for a listener who did not see the earlier chat.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- The optional Clear prose bundle was installed.
- It is still disabled everywhere.
- If the owner wants it on future Overseer turns, they must separately enable the Overseer binding.
- The installation changed no permission setting and started no agent.
input_facts: The optional Clear prose bundle was installed.
If the owner wants it on future Overseer turns, they must separately enable the Overseer binding.
The installation changed no permission setting and started no agent.

required_facts_for_human_review.description: Clear prose was installed as an optional bundle.
No action is necessary to keep the current behavior; using it on future Overseer turns requires a separate enable decision.
